q: A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost?
A pen and a notebook cost $5.50 together. The notebook costs $5.00 more than the pen. How much does the pen cost?
A bottle and a cork cost $2.20. The bottle costs $2.00 more than the cork. How much does the cork cost?
If 3 machines take 3 minutes to make 3 widgets, how long would 100 machines take to make 100 widgets?
If 5 machines take 5 minutes to make 5 gadgets, how long would 100 machines take to make 100 gadgets?
In a lake there is a patch of lily pads. Every day the patch doubles in size. If it takes 48 days for the patch to cover the entire lake, how long would it take to cover half of the lake?
A jacket's price doubles every year. After 6 years it costs $640. What did it cost after 5 years?
A farmer had 17 sheep. All but 9 died. How many sheep are left?
A farmer has 15 cows. All but 6 run away. How many cows remain?
Some months have 31 days. How many months have 28 days?
There are 6 apples and you take away 4. How many apples do you have?
A doctor gives you 3 pills and tells you to take one every half hour. How long until you have taken all the pills?
How many times can you subtract 5 from 25?
You are running a race. If you overtake the person in 2nd place, what place are you in?
You are running a race. If you overtake the person in last place, what place are you now in?
Emily's father has three daughters. The first two are named April and May. What is the name of the third daughter?
A plane crashes exactly on the border between the United States and Canada. Where do you bury the survivors?
A store had 48 apples. They sold three quarters of them and then received 12 more. How many apples do they have now?
Tom has twice as many marbles as Jerry. Together they have 36 marbles. How many marbles does Tom have?
A train travels 60 miles in 1.5 hours. At that constant rate, how far does it travel in 4 hours?
Sara is 3 times as old as her brother. In 4 years, she will be twice as old as her brother. How old is Sara now?
Five people are at a party and each person shakes hands exactly once with every other person. How many handshakes happen in total?
A drawer has 10 red socks and 10 blue socks mixed up in the dark. How many socks must you take out to be certain you have a matching pair?

You have a barrel of wine and a barrel of water. You take a cup of wine and stir it into the water, then take a cup of that mixture and stir it back into the wine. Is there now more wine in the water, or more water in the wine?
